subject.title: docs(gateway): add launchd supervisor loop troubleshooting

question: Should OpenClaw publish this docs-first launchd recovery runbook before the generated-wrapper and doctor/install fixes are implemented?
rationale: The patch is docs-only and technically coherent, but it asks operators to mutate launchd services in a way that can affect node-service availability; automation should not decide that product/support tradeoff.

options.title: Land Docs-First Runbook
options.body: Publish the runbook with the node-service skip warning and keep durable runtime hardening tracked in the linked issue.

options.title: Hold For Runtime Fix
options.body: Defer this PR until wrapper generation, doctor detection, or install hardening makes the recovery path less manual.

options.title: Require Narrower Wording
options.body: Ask for maintainer-specific prerequisites around when disabling ai.openclaw.node is acceptable before merge.

recommendation.title: Land Docs-First Runbook
recommendation.body: Publish the runbook with the node-service skip warning and keep durable runtime hardening tracked in the linked issue.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the strongest routing match across the docs, launchd, service-env, and supervisor-marker history gathered for the product choice.
